historical_context: During Stage 1 and Stage 2 of MP1-V002, the operational handoff reported 10 full-text papers, while an interim audit snapshot on disk referenced 13 papers and the final matrix commit expanded to 16 papers.
difference: Discrepancy in evidence matrix paper count (10 vs 13 vs 16 full-text papers).
why_it_matters: Discrepancy in evidence matrix paper count (10 vs 13 vs 16 full-text papers) directly impacts the completeness of prior art threats evaluated for C1–C8.

historical_context: The automated audit runner recorded niti_requires_distinct_constitutive_contact_coupling = true with evidence_status = established, whereas project handoffs recorded evidence_status = insufficient and verdict = false.
difference: Semantic conflict between claiming established need for distinct coupling vs insufficient evidence.
why_it_matters: Conflict between claiming established need for distinct NiTi contact coupling vs insufficient evidence directly determines whether claim C7 can survive as a new constitutive law.

source_B: Carboni et al. (2015) primary PDF (doi:10.1061/(ASCE)EM.1943-7889.0000852, Table 4, pp. 9–10) and docs/reports/MP1_ASTRA_SCIENTIFIC_CRITIQUE_2026-09-25.md (G05)
historical_context: Stage 1 extraction worker W08 asserted that Carboni 2015 configuration S2a proved NiTi phase transformation under pure cyclic bending.
difference: Factually incorrect specimen material and loading identification: S2a was ST49 steel wire rope with Bouc-Wen friction, whereas S1a was NiTi7 under tension-bending.
why_it_matters: Attributing steel wire rope (S2a) to NiTi pure bending misled early evaluations of C5 and C7; rectifying this leaves NiTi pure-bending contact unverified in Carboni 2015.

historical_context: Stage 3 evidence report was finalized before the final citation screening of branches B11 (Kang 2020) and B12 (Barsi 2025). The report recorded stop_condition_satisfied = false, whereas later Stage 4 closed all 15/15 directions.
difference: Citation coverage status disagreement: stop_condition_satisfied = false in Stage 3 report vs stop_condition.satisfied = true in canonical JSON.
why_it_matters: Disagreement on citation stopping condition between Stage 3 narrative (false) and canonical JSON (true) impacts closure confidence for mechanics claims.

historical_context: Early MP1-V002 framing treated actively varied positive confinement pressure P3 as a potentially novel mechanics principle that distinguished MP1 from passive metallic cables.
difference: Active pressure treated as novel mechanics principle vs experimental control boundary condition.
why_it_matters: Demoting actively varied positive pressure P3 from a novel mechanics principle to an experimental boundary condition closes C6 as an independent mechanics contribution.

historical_context: MP1-V002 final adjudication concluded that MP1 survived its targeted citation chase and was ready for thesis consideration, proposing working titles in English and Vietnamese.
difference: Candidate thesis direction ready for execution vs archived viable alternative not selected for current MSc.
why_it_matters: Discrepancy between candidate thesis readiness and archived viable alternative dictates the final disposition of MP1 across the entire project.
